# Embree 4.4.0 C API

The headers are from Intel Embree v4.4.0, licensed under Apache-2.0. The configured rtcore_config.h is from the official Linux x86-64 release. It matches the Windows x64 release after line-ending normalization. Local copies normalize trailing whitespace. Both archives were verified against the SHA-256 hashes pinned by embreex 4.4.0.post1. The game loads the binary shipped with that wheel.
